title: Symrise appoints four new perfumers to its Paris creative hub
summary: Symrise Fine Fragrance strengthens its Paris Creative Center with the arrival of four perfumers: Philippe Paparella-Paris, Théo Belmas, Leslie Girard and Margaux Le Paih Guérin. “Our ambition in Paris is to bring together exceptional perfumers, across different generations, backgrounds and creative sensibilities, around a shared passion for excellence,” said Mehdi Lisi, SVP Global Fine Fragrance Creation, Symrise.
